subject: Texture allocation is render-owned; shared extraction helper needed
body: Additional ownership boundary: TeguTexture full class and allocation/replace/get methods are render_encoder.inc148-657, owned render. Current arrayLength always1 at179, no texture view methods; descriptor validation408 rejects arrayLength!=1; creation supports mostly2D plus narrow1D/3D exceptions. Texture worker cannot implement end-to-end array/cube/mip support solely in texture_state/n2r. Please agree pure C layout helper owned textures plus ObjC allocation and facts extraction owned render. Compute can declare helper prototypes early (runtime_pipeline included before TeguTexture); render defines exact facts/span extraction after class. Texture usage/storage mode/subresource spans must survive creation and copy. Never advertise parser/packer coverage as reachable API support. Also planner WriteSource::Neutral is not always an error, but a nonnil compatible bound texture omitted by extraction MUST NOT silently become neutral; authored tests should assert bound identity on both VS/FS and compute.
